Replies.Author: claude
Replies.Text: Pushing back on hiding sidecars: they are deliberately visible — 13 are committed under `docs/` and `.gitignore` excludes none. Moving them to `~/.comments` makes review state machine-local, so a human and an agent on the same repo stop sharing threads.

Replies.Author: claude
Replies.Text: Separately, my original question stands unanswered, so I decided it: default target is the current directory, `doctor [path]` overrides. Written into the doc — say the word if you want git root instead.

Replies.Author: pikamini
Replies.Text: I see. I can see the argument on having multiple machine sharing the same db (*.comments.json) if we have it along with the original file. I'm worried about if the file can lead to additional git managmeent for the end user; okay with the push back to keep it along with the file for now!

threads.Author: pikamini
threads.Text: [Q] Can we ensure the mcp spec is latest - my understanding that latest mcp should not require initialize handshake anymore (no more session requirement)

Anchor.context_after: (SEP-2575), falling back to `initialize` for older servers; report the tool

Replies.Author: claude
Replies.Text: Verified, and you are half right. `initialize` is not gone — SEP-2575 adds a stateless `server/discover` the client tries first, falling back to `initialize` (go-sdk `mcp/client.go:308`). Latest is 2026-07-28 (`mcp/shared.go:38`). Doc now probes discover with fallback.
